Parkfest at Altamont Fairgrounds

with 50 Cent, Coheed and Cambria, Finch, Thrice, The Used, The Promise Ring, Recover, The Movielife, Midtown, Story of the Year, Onelinedrawing

  • May 3, 2003
  • Altamont, New York

Outdoor festival at Altamont Fairgrounds, west of Albany — a long day of emo. These photos were in my photo archive, but I don’t think I took them all, or used my camera. It may have been a combo of us sharing camera duties, if memory serves.
